predictions.rationale: Central coordinator of the cognitive subsystem; owns the to-do list, manages critics and background review cycles that continuously analyze the design.
Represents the collection of autonomous "agents" (critics) and dispatches them; core to running background analyses and gathering improvement suggestions.
Implements the control mechanism that decides when and how critics are invoked during background reasoning, directly enabling continuous analysis.
Default implementation of the control mechanism; drives periodic activation of critics and manages their scheduling in the background thread.
Boot-straps and launches the critic background thread at application start-up, directly supporting the continuous agent execution feature.
Abstract superclass for all critic agents that detect design problems and propose improvements; fundamental to implementing the suggestion mechanism.
Holds the collection of suggestions generated by critics; central data structure that designers interact with to view and manage improvement items.
Encapsulates individual suggestions/reminders produced by critics, including problem description and proposed fixes.
Aggregates multiple critics to generate higher-level advice, contributing sophisticated expert-level suggestions to the to-do list.
User-interface component that displays the live to-do suggestions to the designer, directly supporting interaction with the continuous critique feature.
